name: Siding
summary: James Hardie fiber cement, replaced or installed new. High return on investment, and it doesn't cup, fade or rot.
detail: We replace failing wood, stucco and composite siding with James Hardie fiber cement — the material that takes a Southern California summer without cupping, fading or feeding anything. We're a James Hardie Elite Contractor, which is the top tier of their programme, and siding is the trade we're best known for.
alt: A single-storey Rancho Palos Verdes home finished in white James Hardie lap siding under a clear blue sky.
